sections.heading: MAJOR IN SOCIOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements, including Sociology 1020, Sociology 1020W/X or Sociology 1021E with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course from: Sociology 2240E or Sociology 2270A/B and Sociology 2271A/B.
1.0 course in Sociology at the 2100 or 2200 level.
1.5 additional Sociology courses at the 2200 level.
1.0 Sociology courses at the 3000 level or above.
Note: Students registered in an Honours Double Major in Sociology AND Criminology must have at least 0.5 course at the 4000-level in Sociology at King’s.
